subject: Access ownership rollup & redaction plan (SIG / CAIQ intake)
messages:
From: Allison Park <allison.park@finedge.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: SIG / CAIQ intake — access ownership & sample artifacts

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking this on. FinEdge is working through the SIG intake for our SOC 2 scope and a couple of items we need from Redwood are: a canonical role->user mapping export (CSV or spreadsheet), SCIM delta logs for the last 90 days, and a couple of SAML assertion samples showing NameID and role claims. We are trying to validate least-privilege controls and service-account ownership.

Could you confirm whether you can provide:
- a role mapping CSV with role description and owner (e.g., role_name, user_email, role_owner)
- SCIM delta (adds/updates/deletes) for the last 90 days or guidance on how to pull it if we need a signed export
- two SAML assertion samples (production and a QA sample) with header comments redacted as needed

Requested delivery: by EOD Wednesday (2025-11-26) if possible — we can accept a staged handoff (initial rollup followed by raw logs). Also flag any artifacts that require redaction.

Attaching a short intake template (filled-in fields would be helpful).

Thanks,
Allison Park
Compliance Lead — FinEdge
allison.park@finedge.com

--- attachment: intake_template.pdf (see attached: initial_intake_form.pdf)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
To: Allison Park <allison.park@finedge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ intake — access ownership & sample artifacts

Hi Allison — thanks for the clear ask and the template. We can provide the items you listed; plan below.

Planned deliverables (staged):
1) Canonical role->user rollup (CSV) — includes role_name, role_description, current_members (email list), role_owner (name + contact), last_changed. Will deliver a sample CSV and the full export.
2) SCIM delta export (last 90 days) — we will provide a signed ndjson export of add/update/delete events and an extraction report (time window and query used).
3) SAML assertion samples — one production-escaped sample and one QA sample. We will redact any PII in the header but preserve relevant claim structure (NameID, roles, instance ids).
4) Service-account mapping — we will include a separate sheet for service accounts and their binding to roles.

Owners / timeline:
- Karthik Iyer (infra) — SCIM extraction & signed export (owner)
- Jordan Blake (sec/compliance) — redaction checklist & assertion sample vetting
- Rachel Kim (you + FinEdge) — primary contact and deliverable coordinator

We have a Drive folder ready: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-finedge-intake (will drop artifacts there). Expect initial rollup by 2025-11-21 EOD and full logs by 2025-11-24. If you need faster delivery for any particular artifact, note it in reply.

Attached an internal intake template we’ll use to track required fields.

— Rachel
Rachel Kim
Security & Trust — Redwood Inference
rachel@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ intake — SCIM extraction plan and query snippets

Rachel / Jordan — quick technical plan:

Scope: SCIM provisioning logs (adds/updates/deletes) for the tenant(s) that serve FinEdge. We'll pull the event stream from the provisioning pipeline (Kafka topic: provisioning.events) and materialize a delta for the requested period.

Artifacts I will produce:
- scim_delta_2025-08-21_to_2025-11-19.ndjson (signed)
- role_mapping_rollup_20251121.csv (role_name, description, members_count, members_sample, role_owner)
- service_account_mapping_20251121.csv (service_account_email, linked_role, last_used_timestamp)
- scim_query_snippets.sql (queries used to generate the rollup)

Redaction notes:
- We'll redact IP addresses from headers and truncate jwt IDs in the sample assertions.
- For user emails we will provide full emails as FinEdge requested for mapping; if FinEdge asks for masked PII we can create a masked version later.

ETA: initial CSV rollup + service-account mapping by 2025-11-21 EOD; signed SCIM NDJSON by 2025-11-24. I attached the SQL snippets and a header README explaining the signing process.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Infrastructure Engineer — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

From: Allison Park <allison.park@finedge.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ intake — access ownership & sample artifacts

Hi Rachel / team — this looks great, thank you. The timeline fits our intake window. Couple of quick follow-ups:

- For service accounts: can you include last-used timestamps (we want to validate stale credentials)? The service_account_mapping CSV sample you called out should include last_used_timestamp and owner_contact.
- On the SCIM NDJSON: can the file be PGP-signed? That helps our secure ingestion pipeline.
- If possible, include a short README in the Drive folder describing which fields were redacted and why.

If those items are okay, we’ll expect the initial role_mapping_rollup_20251121.csv and service_account_mapping_20251121.csv in the Drive folder; then the signed SCIM export on 2025-11-24. Once we have those, FinEdge will run a mapping check and circle back with any gaps.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Allison
Allison Park
Compliance Lead — FinEdge
allison.park@finedge.com
